headline: Protesters Breach Microsoft AI Data-Centre Site in Amsterdam
summary: Activists breached a Microsoft artificial intelligence data-centre site in Amsterdam as growing European opposition to resource-intensive data facilities mounts.
why: Public and environmental pushback against large-scale data center infrastructure can introduce operational risks and permitting delays for cloud service providers in Europe.
